description: Search the Tennessee Code Annotated (T.C.A.) BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "security deposit", "concealed carry", "DUI per se limit", "homicide". This matches OFFICIAL CATCHLINES/HEADINGS (e.g. "39-13-202. First degree murder." matches "murder"), not the full statutory body text — a word that appears only inside a section's text and not its heading will not be found this way. Returns matching citations, catchlines and chapter context; call tn_statute with a citation for the full text. Same 2021-05-21 point-in-time snapshot as tn_statute. Keyless.
name: tn_search
title: Tn Search
